source:
@@U00050@@
No, Lord! It was a mess to start with, and it’s a mess still. How I pity those poor people! They're so miserable. I haven't the heart to plague them, poor things.

@@U00052@@
Do you know 浮士德?

@@U00054@@
The doctor?

@@U00056@@
He's my servant.

@@U00058@@
Servant! Well! He certainly has an odd way of serving! No earthly food or drink for that fool! The ferment in him has driven him so far that he almost half knows his folly. He demands of heaven its fairest star, and of earth its wildest abandon. Nothing, near or far, ever satisfies him.

@@U00060@@
He may be confused at present, but I'll soon lead him into the light. The gardener knows that when the tree turns green blossoms and fruit can’t be far behind.

@@U00062@@
What will you wager? You'll lose him yet, you will, if you allow me to lead him gently down my primrose path.
translation:
@@U00050@@
不，主啊！一开始就很混乱，现在仍然很混乱。我多么可怜那些可怜的人啊！他们太惨了我不忍心去折磨他们，可怜的东西。

@@U00052@@
你知道浮士德吗？

@@U00054@@
医生？

@@U00056@@
他是我的仆人。

@@U00058@@
仆人！出色地！他的服务方式确实很奇怪！那个傻瓜没有世间的食物或饮料！他内心的骚动已经驱使他走得太远，以至于他几乎已经知道自己的愚蠢了。他要求天上有最美丽的星星，要求地上有最狂野的遗弃。没有什么，无论远近，都不能令他满意。

@@U00060@@
他现在可能很困惑，但我很快就会带领他走向光明。园丁知道，当树变绿时，花朵和果实也就不远了。

@@U00062@@
你会打赌什么？你还是会失去他的，你会的，如果你允许我轻轻地引导他走上我的报春花之路。
